audience: practice staff who manage the schedule and patient records in DrChrono

useCases.title: See the appointments for a day
useCases.text: The AI lists the appointments for a date, by doctor or office. You see the time, the patient and the status of each visit.

useCases.title: Review one patient's clinical summary
useCases.text: The AI finds the patient and lists the problems, medications and allergies on file. You get a short summary before the visit.

useCases.title: Check the lab orders and results of a patient
useCases.text: The AI lists the lab orders of one patient and the results that came back. You see which orders still wait for a result.

useCases.title: Review payments and charges for a patient
useCases.text: The AI lists the payments and the billing line items of one patient. You can compare what was charged with what was paid.

useCases.title: Add a new patient and book a visit
useCases.text: The AI creates the patient record and books an appointment with a doctor and office. It shows the details and waits for your OK first.
